name: Home Village: The Warning

npcs.name: Aling Rosa
dialogue: The warning says a typhoon is turning toward our village.
Please help me secure the windows, then bring our go-bag to the shelter.
after_dialogue: You helped our neighbors get ready. Stay with the group and follow the shelter signs.

choice.prompt: Should we board up the windows now? It takes time, and the storm is getting closer.

options.result: Windows boarded! The storm pressure rises, but the home is protected.
options.mascot: Boarding takes time, but it protects the home from wind-borne glass.
options.consequence: You boarded the windows. It cost time, but the glass stayed intact and the house was protected.

options.result: You left immediately. The family is safer, but the house is exposed.
options.mascot: Leaving quickly protects people. The unboarded windows may still break.
options.consequence: You skipped the windows. You saved time, but strong wind broke the glass and damaged the house.

npcs.name: Jun
dialogue: I heard the typhoon alert at school. I packed water and a flashlight.
I am ready to walk with the other families to the shelter.
after_dialogue: Our class is together now. We will stay inside until the all-clear.

quests.title: Find a first-aid kit before the storm reaches the evacuation center.

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety.

quests.supplies: Look for the green go-bag. Every family needs one ready for an emergency.
quests.flashlight: A flashlight is important when the power goes out. Look for the yellow item.
quests.talk_nena: Aling Rosa needs help. Walk up to the orange person and press E.
quests.evac: Head to the blue Evacuation Center in the bottom-right corner.

lessons: Learn the controls and identify your safe evacuation area.
Prepare a go-bag and help neighbors follow the community plan.
Follow local instructions and use the marked safe route.

quiz.question: What should you do when local officials order your community to evacuate?
options: Follow the designated route and help neighbors move safely
Wait until the hazard reaches your home
Take an unmarked shortcut through floodwater
quiz.explanation: Follow local authority instructions and use the designated safe route.

briefing: Begin in the small home village where the player grew up. A strange signal appears as neighbors prepare for the first evacuation.
story_clue: A brief pulse of radio static interrupts an otherwise ordinary morning.
